verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's Workflows feature lets users attach multi-action automations to scheduling links that trigger automatically on meeting lifecycle events (booked, canceled, reminders) without manual intervention, and further extend via Zapier for CRM/task automations — this matches autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of workflow reliability, evidence of conditional/branching logic or scheduled (non-event-triggered) automations, and any AI-specific automation capability.
